reviewed_by: Codex focused review for assistant direct-request guidance
reason: A clear operator command should reach the provider or harness with guidance to act without repeat confirmation. Six collected Python tests cover the shared instruction in provider and harness prompts, distinct approvals, and tool availability. One production-LAN real-Core assistant journey is selected in desktop Chromium, mobile Chromium, and mobile WebKit; it checks the actual model request and visible reply.
exclusions: No React component, styling, native runtime, or browser-origin contract changed, so frontend unit and native tests are excluded. The three selected real-Core browser cases cover the changed assistant journey; unrelated chat, harness, settings, and full suites are excluded. A model stub verifies prompt delivery and UI completion, not live model compliance or physical-device behavior.
